You ask Nera Moss for the blue cord, and she steps onto her ferry.
You, the second person, step onto mine. We have a little time. You, I, are silent.

You: Did you bring me the blue cord? It seems to be missing from your hand. Can I get it?

Nera Moss: Yes, of course! I'll give you one moment to use it. Please hold on.

[Scenario: A harbor]

The horizon is shrouded by a veil of mist. The water is still, yet not quite moving. You hear the soft sound of waves in the distance. A faint scent of saltwater fills your nostrils.

You: So, what's this about? It seems strange but it's true...

[Entity: Nera Moss]
Character. An old woman who knows every part of the sea. She has lived in Bellwether for decades, observing the mysteries of the ocean.

[Entity: Glasswater Flats]
Location. A small island where glassfish swim, offering their translucent bodies as food for jellyfish and octopus larvae. These are rare treasures known only to those with vast knowledge.

[Entity: Mara Vale]
Character. A captain returning from the seas, looking at the horizon with the same keen eye that watches over the harbor.

[Fact: The Seventh Lantern]
last lit: Seven years ago, when Mara left town, she lost her friend Nira, who was also an elderly keeper of the Ninth Lantern. She didn't know about the new lantern until seven more years had passed. But she didn’t want to find out because it would make her feel like she wasn't enough, so she decided to keep using the old one. They were sealed together by their life experiences. They both knew they wouldn’t forget each other, so she chose the Seventh Lantern for them. Her friend was very much missed by her, and she felt like she was missing her too. As her friend grew older, she felt like she wasn’t enough, so she kept using the Seventh Lantern instead of a new one.
